description.value: Araxi is a celebrated restaurant and oyster bar with over 45 years of history in the heart of Whistler Village, internationally recognized for its farm-to-table approach under James Beard-nominated Culinary Director James Walt. The kitchen draws on locally sourced BC ingredients from nearby farms and pristine coastal waters, delivering seasonally driven menus that have earned consistent top-restaurant honours in the province. Its wine program spans over 11,000 bottles and 1,000+ labels, earning Wine Spectator's Award of Excellence every year from 2013 to 2025.
